id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_050.pack|cs_: "F-Forgive us. The monsters on the mountain path were too strong, and we could not find the hermit.
"Ah, {var:1}, Hendrik. About two weeks ago a hermit visited the temple and headed for the summit of Mount Pang Lai.
"I don't know. When he heard the Grand Master had died, he said nothing and went to the summit.
"Monsters on the mountain have grown violent under Mordegon's influence, so I sent warrior monks to rescue him, but...
"As you see, they came back wounded. I was wondering what to do.
"Training every day, yet unable to use it when it matters... I'm so useless.
"...Then how about we go rescue that hermit?
"I'm grateful, but you have an important mission. I can't trouble you.
"{var:1}, what do you say? We owe the people here a night's lodging. Let's help him.
"Come now. It's fate that brought us here at this time. Let's help the High Lama.
"Thank you. But I can't rely on your kindness alone. Please let me come with you.
"Then let us head for the summit at once. Leave the temple and take the east road.
"Then let us head for the summit. Go through the cave south of Angri-La, and the entrance is beyond the sign."
